newsitem.title: USA: Loehmann's sinks after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Loehmann's sinks after profit warning.

text.p: Shares of Loehmann's Inc fell heavily in early trading on Friday after the retailer said it expected quarterly earnings to fall well below expectations.

Analysts had been predicting earnings for the quarter ending May 3 at about $0.32 a share compared with $0.27 last year on a proforma basis. But Loehmann's said it expects earnings of between $0.14 and $0.20 a share in its announcement after the market close on Thursday.
Shares slumped sharply, falling over 20 percent on the Nasdaq. The stock fell 2-1/2 to 8-3/8.
Investors apparently anticipated the retailer's poor earnings; the stock is nearly 50 percent below its levels iof the beginning of the month, with its April 2 close at 16.
Loehmann's cited lower same-store sales and high costs to open three new stores ahead of schedule.
First quarter results will be reported on or about May 28, 1997.
